origin.description: NULL when nothing is named. An unnamed argument is an empty string when something else is named.
origin.details: The caller stores a Dots sequence in _dots. A caller with no _dots is an error.
origin.example:
bp_...names <- getFromNamespace("...names", "backports")
foo <- function(...) bp_...names()
print(foo(a = 1, b = 2, 3))
print(foo(1, 2))
